notice: These component mutations are real tests of implemented modules, not the required database/HTTP/broker/browser defect experiments. They do not satisfy G07.

probes.title: IDEMPOTENCY_PAYLOAD_MISMATCH
probes.mechanism: Fingerprint ignores economically meaningful intent values.

probes.title: STALE_EVENT_OVERWRITE
probes.mechanism: Remove both version and terminal-state protection; an old full snapshot overwrites SETTLED.

probes.title: REVERSAL_AFTER_REFUND
probes.mechanism: A full reversal forgets a previous successful partial refund.

probes.title: FLOATING_POINT_AMOUNT_PARSE
probes.mechanism: Float/truncate conversion changes CAD 0.29 into 28 minor units.

probes.title: UNCHECKED_MONEY_OVERFLOW
probes.mechanism: Unchecked addition wraps; the secondary constructor defense prevents corruption but the controlled overflow error contract regresses.

probes.title: WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH
probes.mechanism: Omit the event identity from the signed bytes; receiver interoperability and replay binding break.

probes.title: FIXED_24H_RECURRENCE
probes.mechanism: Add a fixed UTC day instead of preserving the intended Halifax wall-clock time.
probes.after: return recurrence == Recurrence.DAILY ? resolve(intended, zone).plusSeconds(86400) : resolve(next(intended, recurrence), zone);
